# AK Harbors

> Independent boater's guide to Alaska small-boat harbors (Homer, Seward, Whittier, Valdez, Kodiak, Juneau, Ketchikan), transient moorage, tides, launching and seasons.

Educational resource; not affiliated with any harbor or agency. No moorage rates are published; confirm details with harbor offices, NOAA and the NWS.

## Pages

- [Alaska Harbors Guide: Small-Boat Ports, Moorage, Tides and Launching](https://akharbors.com/): Overview of Alaska harbors and the boating guides.
- [Southcentral Alaska Harbors: Homer, Seward, Whittier and Valdez](https://akharbors.com/southcentral-alaska-harbors.html): Road-accessible harbors on Kachemak Bay, Resurrection Bay and Prince William Sound.
- [Southeast Alaska and Kodiak Harbors: Juneau, Ketchikan and Kodiak](https://akharbors.com/southeast-alaska-kodiak-harbors.html): What to know about harbors you reach by water, ferry or air.
- [Transient Moorage in Alaska: A Visiting Boater's Guide](https://akharbors.com/transient-moorage-alaska.html): How to find a slip, check in with the harbormaster and be a good guest.
- [Alaska Tides for Boaters: Tide Tables, Currents and Big Ranges](https://akharbors.com/alaska-tides-for-boaters.html): Reading tide tables, big ranges, currents and why minus tides matter.
- [Boat Launching and Boating Seasons in Alaska](https://akharbors.com/boat-launching-alaska.html): Launch ramp tips, safety gear, cold water, and boating through the year.
- [About AK Harbors](https://akharbors.com/about.html): Who we are and what we cover.
- [Contact AK Harbors](https://akharbors.com/contact.html): How to reach us by email.
- [Privacy Policy](https://akharbors.com/privacy.html): How this site handles your information.
